# KayKit Character Animations

Selected humanoid animation files live under `AdventurersAnimations/`. This folder currently contains animation files from the KayKit Adventurers import; its name does not imply a complete standalone animation pack.

The current visual pass uses idle, running, hit, and death clips. Attack and dodge/evade animations remain placeholders. See the [asset license manifest](../../Licenses/ASSET_LICENSES.md) for provenance, selected clips, and the missing standalone-license-file note.

Keep imports limited to needed clips and validate bindings using the [development guide](../../../../DEVELOPMENT.md).
